distractors.reason: We don't say 'believe on' for this meaning. 'Believe' takes 'in' for trust or faith: believe in your team, believe in the plan.
We don't say 'arrive on' for this meaning. 'Arrive' takes 'at' or 'in' for places: arrive at the office, arrive in London.
We don't say 'wait on' for this meaning. 'Wait' takes 'for' when we expect something: wait for the results.

l1_interference: В українській мові 'залежати' зазвичай поєднується з прийменником 'від', але носії можуть помилково сказати 'depend of' або 'depend to'. В англійській це дієслово завжди вимагає прийменника 'on'.
explanation: In English, 'depend' is almost always followed by 'on' when we say that one thing needs another thing to happen or to be true. The preposition is fixed, so students must learn the pair together.

related_collocations.example: We can rely on our suppliers.
The bank wants to invest in new technology.
She applied for a loan last week.

memory_tip: DEPEND ON = need something to be true or to work | BELIEVE IN = trust a person or an idea
